name: June's Bread
ingredients: 8-10 cup – Flour, white and whole wheat blended (recommend 50/50 or 60/40)
instructions: Combine first three ingredients, water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 10 minutes until yeast is bubbly and active
Combine scalded milk, butter, sugar, and salt and let sit until cool to the touch
Mix the yeast and milk mixture together then add half the flour in a mix-master.
Mix for 10 minutes in the mix-master or 15 minutes by hand
Add remaining flour and knead until dough squeaks
Add kneaded dough to a lightly oiled bowl
Let rise for 45 minutes in a warm place (turned off oven), place boiling water in a pan in the oven with the bowl of rising dough
Shape into loaf pans: flatten the dough to push the air out, slow fold in to the loaf lump compressing the air out after each fold. Fold in the ends of the rolled loaf and place in loaf tin
Let rise again for 45 minutes in the tins
With about 20 minutes left in the second rise, preheat the oven to 375˚F
After the second rise is complete and the oven is at temperature, bake bread for 20-30 minutes until the crust is golden brown

additional_context.source: June is Isaac's Granny and this recipe came from her. It is our family's favourite bread to make and to eat!
